does_not_do: Detection is pattern- and model-based and can miss or over-match; it does not guarantee anonymity.
focus_reason: It is built for exactly this need, with separate analyzer and anonymizer packages and tests in CI. 6 releases in the year; 108 open issues.
measured_against: Need: find and redact personal information in text before it is shared or stored.
tests_ci: Tests inside each package and an e2e-tests/ directory; CI and CodeQL workflows.
what_it_is: A framework for detecting, redacting, masking and anonymizing personal information in text, images and structured data. The repository moved from microsoft/presidio.
